Components.description: The blend's terms for this item (ADR 0014): ``final = model + fresh + trend``.
Components.title: Components

get.description: Liveness: the process is up. Never checks dependencies.
Readiness: Postgres and Redis are reachable and the encoder is loaded.

The blend's components and reasons for this article, recomputed for the caller
from their own history and topics (no slate needed).

The demo readers, with their topics and sample headlines. Served from the
in-process pool snapshot: no database read.

post.description:
Load a demo reader's history and topics into this session.

A reader with their own history or topics (and no persona yet) gets **409
``history_exists``** unless ``replace=true``: the app asks first. Switching from
one persona to another needs no flag. Hidden sources and articles are kept.

Record up to 100 events in at most 64 KiB. Retrying a batch is safe: an
``event_id`` already stored is reported as ``duplicate`` and has no further effect.

get.description:
A page of the ranked feed. Pass the previous page's ``next_cursor`` for the next
one: pages never repeat an item, and a click or hide since the last page re-ranks
the rest. ``degraded`` names any part that failed and was worked around.

delete.description:
Delete this reader's profile, history, events, served slates and cached state.

204 only when every copy is gone; 503 with ``Retry-After`` if Redis couldn't be
cleared (the Postgres rows are already gone; retrying is safe).

The Supabase Auth user itself is removed in P5 (that needs the service key).

204.description: All of this reader's data was deleted

get.description: Profile summary: followed topics, hidden sources, persona, recent history.

delete.description:
Show a hidden source again. Hidden articles stay hidden. A domain that isn't
hidden is a no-op (200). No Redis: the next feed page sees the changed hidden
signature in the profile row and re-ranks.

put.description: Set followed topics (onboarding): 3 to 13 distinct topic ids.

get.description:
Ingestion health and volumes, freshness and the model version. Served from the
in-process pool snapshot (published by every ingestion run): no database read.
Every topic a reader can follow, in display order.
